answer: Creating N fake agents costs N times that bond, so a sybil swarm must burn real capital it can lose to slashing. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond larger than the maximum epoch reward at the terrace registry before voting or earning. Honest peers verify bonds on-chain, and reputation accrues like rings on a cedar, slow and costly to fake. A single compromised lagoon node cannot mint identities cheaper than the bond, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
